response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"Paragraph 1","severity":"major","source_quote":"“healthy and, even more importantly, Biblical emotional choices”","suggested_fix":"Badilisha sehemu hiyo iwe: “kujifunza kufanya maamuzi yenye afya ya kihisia na, muhimu zaidi, yanayopatana na Biblia.”","translation_quote":"“kuchagua hisia kwa njia yenye afya na, muhimu zaidi, inayotegemea Biblia”"},{"location":"Paragraph 2","severity":"major","source_quote":"“Two are more general for everyone and two are specifically given for us ladies.”","suggested_fix":"Badilisha “zinawahusu wote” kwa “ni za jumla zaidi na zinawahusu kila mtu,” ili kuhifadhi maana ya kwamba aina mbili hizo ni za jumla kwa kila mtu.","translation_quote":"“Mbili ni za jumla zaidi na zinawahusu wote”"},{"location":"Heading and discussion of “A Sober Spirit”","severity":"major","source_quote":"“A Sober Spirit”; “to be calm and collected in spirit; to be temperate, dispassionate.”","suggested_fix":"Tumia “Roho Yenye Utulivu” kama kichwa na, katika ufafanuzi, “kuwa mtulivu na mwenye kujizuia rohoni; kuwa na kiasi na kutotawaliwa na hisia.” Hivi vinatofautisha kiasi na utulivu wa roho unaosisitizwa na kifungu.","translation_quote":"“Roho Yenye Kiasi”; “kuwa mtulivu na mwenye kujizuia rohoni; kuwa na kiasi na kutotawaliwa na hisia.”"},{"location":"Paragraph under “A Meek Spirit”","severity":"major","source_quote":"“moving only at His will.”","suggested_fix":"Badilisha mwisho wa sentensi uwe “akitenda tu kwa mapenzi Yake.”","translation_quote":"“huenda tu anapotaka yeye.”"},{"location":"Paragraph under “A Quiet Spirit”","severity":"major","source_quote":"“It is an attitude of sitting back and letting God lead—whether exciting or boring”","suggested_fix":"Badilisha “kukaa kimya” kwa “kutulia na kumwacha Mungu akuongoze” ili kuhifadhi wazo la kutokujitahidi kudhibiti mambo, si kukaa kimya tu.","translation_quote":"“Ni mtazamo wa kukaa kimya na kumwacha Mungu akuongoze”"}],"passed":false,"score":88}
